product_summary: ISO 9001:2015 'multi product specialty company'. Real product lines per own website (axivasichem.com): lab filtration (syringe filters, membrane filters, air vent filters, qualitative/quantitative/hardened ashless filter paper, glass fibre filters, filter thimbles, filter funnels, filtration assemblies, SS manifold, vacuum pump for filtration assembly); lab plasticware (PCR plates/strips, centrifuge tubes, petri dishes, cryo boxes, pipette tips, multiwell plates, serological pipettes); lab glassware (culture tubes, haemocytometer, counting chamber, microslides/cover glasses, quartz cuvettes); chromatography columns (C18/C8/silica HPLC columns); molecular biology & diagnostic kits (VTM kit, viral RNA extraction kit); immunodiagnostic components (nitrocellulose membrane, glass fibre sample pad, conjugate release matrix, absorbent pad); bench-top instruments (rotary evaporator, cooling water circulating bath, BOD incubator/hot air oven, UV transilluminator, UVC disinfection, thermal cycler, magnetic/vortex mixer, analytical balance, fume hood, live cell imaging system).
role_hint: manufacturer_trader - claims own manufacturing of CE-marked syringe filters, membrane filters, air vent filters and filter paper, but the catalogue also resells third-party branded HPLC columns (e.g. 'Spheriyoke', 'Ital', 'Axisil' style column names) and instruments, i.e. mixed manufacturer + reseller of lab consumables. No trader-only signs (no 'we are a supplier of all brands' language), but the breadth of unrelated lines (diagnostic kits, PCR plastics, HPLC columns, instruments) suggests significant trading/rebranding activity.
comment: HS 842129 (centrifuges, incl. centrifugal dryers; filtering/purifying machinery and apparatus for liquids or gases) is only PARTIALLY correct. The company does make/sell filtration apparatus - filter funnels, filtration assemblies, SS manifolds, vacuum pump for filtration assembly, syringe filter holders - which plausibly fall in 8421.21/8421.29 territory, so the declared code is not absurd. However, the declared single code covers only a small slice of the actual range: the bulk of the catalogue is lab consumables and instruments that belong in 3926, 7017, 3822/3821, 9027 and 8419. Industry claim 'Металлургия и горнодобыча' (metallurgy & mining) is a clear MISCLASSIFICATION - this is a laboratory equipment / life-science consumables company, not a metals or mining supplier. Per project rule 3 the HS mismatch is NOT a rejection ground: company is retained, code should be corrected to the actual mix (primary 8421.29 for filtration apparatus, plus 3926, 7017, 3822, 9027, 8419 as secondary lines). All product data above is from the company's own website catalogue only - no customs line was available in this task, therefore every product line is 'заявлено, не подтверждено' (declared, not corroborated). No registry, revenue or shipment research was performed per role scope. Note: axiva.com is an unrelated US infusion-therapy company and was excluded; axivasichem.com has an SSL hostname mismatch, content read over http.
